$comment: Single source of truth for the power safety constants shared by the RN app and the firmware. After editing, run `npm run generate:power-safety` and commit the regenerated packages/ble-protocol/src/powerSafety.ts and bt-led-controller/power_safety_constants.h. CI runs `npm run check:power-safety` and fails on any diff.

constants.name: MAX_LED_COUNT
doc: Largest LED count the hardware build supports. Every power check is sized for this worst case.

constants.name: MA_PER_CHANNEL_AT_FULL
doc: Current drawn by one colour channel (R, G or B) of one LED at full value
and full brightness, in mA. Full white on one LED is 3 x this value.

constants.name: MAX_FRAME_CURRENT_MA
doc: Upper bound on the current all LEDs may draw in one frame, in mA.
TODO(battery decision): 400 mA is a placeholder until Cow picks the
battery. Once the battery and its safe continuous discharge are known,
set the real number in packages/ble-protocol/power-safety.json and regenerate.
The firmware header lets a build override it with -DMAX_FRAME_CURRENT_MA=...
